title: Mixed Event — You Are My Hero! — Episode3 Welcome to Meow Park!

meta.Event Outline: On one of his runs, Tsukasa rescues and befriends a stranded cat. At the same time, a cat-themed carnival has arrived in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Cats, cats, cats as far as the eye can see!
What a sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Welcome to my cat-themed carnival, everyone. I call it Meow Park!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Mizuki
rows.Line: I-It's so cute...!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All the rides, attractions and snacks are designed to look like cats...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, look! That shop's selling cat ears and hats and stuff...! They look way too cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, check it out. Isn't that Mikke there over in front of the big slide?! He's this carnival's mascot, so we gotta get a picture with him later...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does the name Mikke come from “mikeneko”? He is based on a calico cat...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Haha. Anyway, I'll leave you all to it.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I'll be walking around the carnival for the most part, so let me know if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Shall we, Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, Nyantaro? Why are you coming over to me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna go with Mr. Inuyama?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He's brushing up against your legs, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Haha. I think he wants to play with you all some more. It seems you've become fast friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Friends...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go around the carnival together...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's a great idea.
It'll be super fun to see everything together!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Hehe. Go right on ahead, Nyantaro.
I hope you all have a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, which ride should we go on first...?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Nyantaro's walking that way...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
He's looking back towards us.
I think he's trying to say, “This way”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha.
Does this mean he's gonna be our guide?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, if that's the case...
Then let's all follow him!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Show us where we should go first, Nyantaro... I mean, partner!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're upgrading him to partner just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this roller coaster's so cute♪
Look at the rails! They're covered in cat paw prints!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Look at that.
I'm a little scared, but at least the design is somewhat comforting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Are you guys feeling okay?
What about you, Tsukasa? You went quiet all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-Nonsense! I don't feel scared at all.
Not one bit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, here comes the drop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not... Scaaaaaaaared!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You get to ride on cats for this merry-go-round. Which should I choose...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna ride the white one because it's got such an adorable bow on it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I'll choose...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, this tabby... It looks just like Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll ride this one...
Giddy up, partner!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You just keep making new friends at every turn, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really wanted this plushie.
Thanks for helping me get it, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't know you were so good at these kinds of shooting galleries.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, it's not so hard once you get the hang of it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you were also really good, Akiyama.
I'm glad you got the prize you wanted...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's because you were such a great teacher! Again, thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where to next, Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really like he's guiding us around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's amazing how smart he is.
He's been waiting patiently outside while we go on rides and stuff. And once we get off, he starts leading us towards the next attraction.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's also basically glued himself to Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I always thought carnivals only had simple or lower-quality rides and attractions. The ones here are surprisingly serious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I read online that the ones here are all handpicked and really sturdy. They've apparently had pretty much the same lineup since the carnival first opened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, these attractions have accompanied Mr. Inuyama to countless different places.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, let's go on the cat merry-go-round again!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: The roller coaster was a little scary, but it ended up being really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They've put smiles on the faces of so many.)

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, he's calling to us.
I think he wants us to go on the big slide next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Let's go, Akiyama, Nene, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, why do you keep calling me by my full name?!
Several hours later
Meow Park Entrance

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The Ferris wheel we went on at the end was so cute! Not only did the gondolas all have cat ears on them, they were covered in paw prints inside too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and you're able to see the whole carnival from the top. I can see why it's the most popular ride!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for being such a great guide, Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we got to have our fill of fun thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. We should come again sometime...!
Maybe we can ask Mr. Inuyama where they'll be touring next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we can also use this opportunity to thank him one last time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Based on what the staff told us, he should be by the gate bidding farewell to the guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that looks like him.
Mr. Inuyama!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, there you all are.
Thank you for visiting today. Did you all have fun?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we did!
Quite a lot of fun, in fact!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The cat designs everywhere were all so cute...!
It honestly felt like bliss...!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
I did invest quite a lot of energy into this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, we were just talking about visiting again. Can you tell us where the next stop for your carnival is going to be...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: The next stop...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that, but I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: This is actually the final stop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?
